text: Harry and I will be waiting for you to get home.
We can do it this time, Gillian.
Not some fake couple like before.
Wait! Wait for me! Take me with you, please!
We didn't have a good frame to work with, so this is just a temporary body.
Just call me Metal Gear, Sega CD for now.
So they found your memory chip in one piece, eh?
Random protected it from the blast of the beam.
Wait a second. I've heard that sneeze somewhere before.
Anyway, I want to know if you'll take me with you.
Please, Gillian, please take me with you.
Hurry up and get on board, partner.
Throughout history, suspicion has always bred conflict.
The real conflict though, resides in people's hearts.
